summary: Digital Realty's indirect finance subsidiary Digital Constellation B.V. issued CHF510 million of senior unsecured guaranteed notes in three tranches: CHF225 million 1.6803% notes due 2029, CHF185 million 2.0600% notes due 2032, and CHF100 million 2.4150% notes due 2036. The notes are fully and unconditionally guaranteed by Digital Realty Trust, Inc., the operating partnership, and Digital Intrepid Holding B.V. The 8-K, filed October 6, 2026, reports the debt issuance under Items 1.01, 2.03, 7.01 and 9.01. This is a routine financing, not a special situation; watch for use of proceeds and leverage impact.
